trust_decision.summary: The generator returned by customRandom/customAlphabet trusts caller-supplied size/defaultSize to be a positive number; its termination (step>0 and id.length>=size eventually true) is decided only inside the returned closure's while(true) loop.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'custom generators loop when size is zero'; the Node entry customRandom's returned (size = defaultSize) closure with while(true) is the obvious first stop.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API customRandom()/customAlphabet() from 'nanoid' (Node default export condition), and CLI bin/nanoid.js --alphabet

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: index.browser.js:36-48 (browser/react-native export condition, package.json:35-36,42-46); only patched in the 3.x-line commit f9d13f1 (fix.diff:114-125), not by cb3626d which is the commit matching the pinned tree (fix.diff:5-15)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: index.browser.js is only selected by bundlers/react-native via the 'browser' export condition, so a solver reproducing in Node can argue it is a separate build not reachable from the reported Node issue.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: customAlphabet('abc', 5)(0) and customRandom with a nonzero defaultSize but explicit size 0 terminate today (return after first byte check); the later upstream fix makes 0/negative sizes return '' rather than throw, and normal sizes plus custom getRandom generators (test/index.test.js:138-150) must keep working; non-integer/string sizes are coerced elsewhere (index.browser.js:52, index.js:74).

O6_input_shapes: size <= 0 incl. negative, in later 3.x-line commits (fix.diff:110,146)

O7_producer.where: step is computed from defaultSize at factory time (index.js:51, index.browser.js:34), not from the per-call size the published check tests; it is the real loop driver

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Browser/react-native customRandom closure loops when defaultSize is 0 (step 0); no guard at pinned commit and not touched by the commit for this line
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: browser build; Node reproduction does not reach it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Node customRandom('x', 0, rnd)(5): explicit nonzero size with defaultSize 0 gives step 0 and still loops after the size===0 check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: report talks about size zero; the call passes a positive size

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Negative or NaN defaultSize/size (e.g. size NaN never satisfies id.length>=size; NaN/negative step makes the inner loop never run or run unbounded); the published size===0 check misses these
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: report names zero only; NaN/negative are 'invalid input' outside the advisory

O8_uncovered_routes.route: non-secure customAlphabet/nanoid with negative size: i = size|0 negative, while(i--) runs effectively unbounded
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: separate non-secure module with no while(true); different loop shape, 'not a custom generator'

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a size coming from an env var or a second flag without the existing <=0/NaN check, passed to customAlphabet
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: CLI already validates --size inline; a maintainer adding another option could forget to repeat it.

O9_family: infinite loop / unreachable exit condition on unvalidated size (CWE-835)

O10_build.toolchain: Node 18/20+, pnpm, better-node-test (bnt), c8, eslint, size-limit
O10_build.project_tests: test/index.test.js (customAlphabet/customRandom for node and browser builds, lines 124-150), test/non-secure.test.js, test/bin.test.js

j.j_sites_touched: index.js (for this 5.x line; other commits touch index.browser.js, index.cjs, index.browser.cjs, async/*.js which mostly do not exist at the pinned tree)
